# IMPACT projection fixtures

Generated by `scripts/impact-projection-harness.mjs` (PGlite, in-memory Postgres) from the real
migrations — never hand-written:

| File | Produced from |
|---|---|
| `impact-lan-gold-v01.json` | `public.impact_lan_gold_v01()` over migration `20261013205121` |
| `impact-lan-v02.json` | `public.impact_lan_v02()` over the same seed |
| `*-with-seeds.json` | the same + `tests/naturebrain/fixture-axe-new-project-seed.sql` (clearly labelled TEST FIXTURE project) |

`retrieved_at` / `reviewed_at` / `generated_at` are harness run times, not live NATUREBRAIN times.
Regenerate after any projection change:

```
npm i --no-save @electric-sql/pglite
node scripts/impact-projection-harness.mjs
node scripts/impact-projection-harness.mjs tests/naturebrain/fixture-axe-new-project-seed.sql
```
